title: SpawnCaptcha
body:
SpawnCaptcha
🚨 Stop bots. Protect your spawn. Keep your economy clean.
SpawnCaptcha is a next-generation anti-bot and anti-autoclick system designed for modern survival and economy servers.
It doesn’t just block bots — it actively filters human vs automated behavior directly at spawn level, where abuse usually starts.
⚡ Why servers use SpawnCaptcha
Most servers fail because: ❌ bots flood spawn
❌ autoclickers farm safe zones
❌ economy gets destroyed instantly
❌ new players get unfairly abused
SpawnCaptcha fixes this at the source.
🧠 Core System
When suspicious behavior is detected at spawn:
👉 A CAPTCHA GUI is triggered
👉 Player must solve a quick challenge
👉 Failure = kick (fully configurable)
No lag. No spam. Just clean protection.
✨ Features
🔒 Smart spawn protection system
⚡ Anti-autoclick detection
🧩 GUI-based CAPTCHA system
⚙️ Fully configurable behavior
🧠 Lightweight performance-first design
🔐 Permission-based bypass system
🔄 Instant reload support
🎯 Built for:
Economy survival servers
Public SMP servers
High-traffic communities
Anti-bot protected hubs
💥 Result
✔ Cleaner spawn
✔ Real players only
✔ Stable economy
✔ Better server reputation
👤 Author
